notizie.titolo: Strengthening the crisis-preparedness community in an interconnected world
notizie.descrizione: In this speech, Dominique Laboureix, Chair of the FSB Resolution Steering Group, discusses the importance of cross-border, cross-sectoral crisis preparedness.

notizie.titolo: FSB Regional Consultative Group for Sub-Saharan Africa meets in Maseru
notizie.descrizione: Central Bank of Lesotho hosts the FSB Sub-Saharan Africa group in Maseru.

notizie.titolo: Innovation and resilience: managing the risks of a changing financial system
notizie.descrizione: In this speech at RiskLive Asia 2026, John Schindler, FSB Secretary General, addresses the importance of international organisations in a shifting geopolitical landscape.

notizie.titolo: FSB finalises sound practices for the responsible adoption of artificial intelligence (AI)
notizie.descrizione: FSB publishes sound practices for financial institutions to adopt, use, and innovate with AI in a responsible manner.

notizie.titolo: Sound Practices for Responsible Adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI): Final report
notizie.descrizione: FSB sets out 12 sound practices to facilitate responsible AI adoption by financial institutions.

notizie.titolo: Sound Practices for Responsible Adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI): Overview of consultation responses
notizie.descrizione: This document summarises the responses to the June 2026 public consultation on the Sound Practices for financial institutions’ responsible AI adoption.
The second report from the FSB strategic review of implementation looks at how the FSB’s policy development process can help improve implementation outcomes.

notizie.titolo: FSB consults on high-level principles for regulatory and supervisory modernisation
notizie.descrizione: FSB seeks feedback on eight high-level principles to assist financial authorities in their modernisation efforts.

notizie.titolo: Regulatory and Supervisory Modernisation Principles: Consultation report
notizie.descrizione: As FSB members review their regulatory and supervisory frameworks, the proposed principles should contribute to efforts to keep such frameworks effective and efficient.

notizie.titolo: Global Stablecoin Arrangements: Cross-border vulnerabilities and financial stability monitoring
notizie.descrizione: This note to the G20 summarises the FSB’s ongoing work on vulnerabilities related to global stablecoins along with data for their financial stability monitoring.
